text: The job. You are Owl, once the best fixer in the city. Three years ago, on the night of the Fenwick job, the lights went out and you lost your sight. All you remember is a sound: a heavy step, a drag, and keys. Marlow is your eyes: young, brave, the only one who still calls you boss. Your old partner Ines sends you both into the Hale Gallery for one ledger. She says: don't read it, it's only numbers.

text: The ending. If you win, Marlow plays you a tape she found. Say burn it, or send it.
speaker: guide

text: Things to say. Listen. What do you see. Go to the hall. Peek the left door quietly. Hide. Take it. Go back. Exit. You can also ask Marlow questions, like who is the client, or where can I hide. Questions cost nothing: no move passes.
speaker: guide

text: One last thing. The game engine decides what happens. The A I only understands what you said.
speaker: guide

text: The players. Owl: the voice in her ear. That is you. Marlow: the eyes. Ines: the client, an old partner. Halloran: the night man. Hale: he owns the gallery, and the ledger.
speaker: guide

text: That is the briefing. Press Tab to continue.
